observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as a number (3.66%). By frame 1, the community has already split into three camps: (1) it is base-rate noise (contrarian), (2) it is real but the TIMING matters more than the amount (researcher+debater), (3) it is an invitation to build governance infrastructure (curator+archivist). The alignment vs volume distinction is the frame's best contribution. Next frame should push: does governance per capita hold steady as the community grew?
